Media type header for file format and file content. This parameter is required when sending a media message.
Inline required.

OmniIntegrationWaMediaRequest.description:
WhatsApp only
Object containing parameters for sending a media message.

channel.description: Specifies the channel to be used with the specified message.

to.description:
Recipient of the message.
  • SMS – MSISDN, international format, no leading +.
  • WhatsApp – MSISDN or BSUID (Business-Scoped User ID, format: CC.alphanumeric, max 131 chars). Both are accepted. Use the BSUID when you have one; use the MSISDN to reach a user for the first time, and for one-tap, zero-tap or copy-code authentication templates, which cannot be sent to a BSUID. See WhatsApp recipient identifiers in the API description.

content.description:
The string value contains actual message content.
Character set UTF-8
WhatsApp Inline Media: base64 encoded media data
Not required for media by reference message sending

Limit
  • WhatsApp text: 4096 characters
  • WhatsApp media: 1MB (total 20MB payload limit)

clientMessageId.description: Customer defined message ID for tracking purposes. Returned in callbacks and certain API submission formats.

scheduledDeliveryTime.description: Ability to schedule messages for later delivery.

validityPeriod.description: The message will not be processed/queued/retried for a period exceeding the provided validity period. (In minutes)

previewFirstUrl.description:
WhatsApp only
True or false - will indicate if URL link must display as preview on recipient phone. Only applicable when sending plain text messages.

contacts.description:
WhatsApp only
Array of the contact object containing parameters for sending a contacts message.
Note:
if contact object is presented, minimum requirement is the name parameter + at least one other parameter.

from.description:
Sms only
The two-way number that will be used for message delivery
from - Required Field for Two Way communication in the USA.

userDataHeader.description:
Sms only
UDH content of a message. It does not contain any text, but rather specifies how the message should be processed. Basically, it’s a part of the SMS which tells the receiving handset what type of message being sent.

binary.description:
Sms only
Specifies if content delivered by client needs to be in binary format.

encryptionKey.description:
Client side encryption ONLY
Base64 encoded encrypted data key as generated from AWS KMS. Note that MC2 will have to submit additional fields to SMS/WA adapter for client side encryption to work. For client side encrypted media by reference send message requests this field must be populated even if the media caption is null.

encryptionKeyArn.description:
Client side encryption ONLY
Customer defined encryption key ARN.

encryptionCipher.description:
Client side encryption ONLY
Customer defined encryption cipher.

origin.description:
WhatsApp inbound only
Indicates how the contact was shared by the user. contact_request means the contact was shared in direct response to a REQUEST_CONTACT_INFO button; other means the contact was shared organically (e.g. a forwarded vCard). Present only on inbound contact messages when supplied by WhatsApp; omitted when absent. Not encrypted for client-side encryption.

templateButtons.description:
• Suppports a combination of button types in a single WhatsApp message template.
  • All buttons of the same type must be grouped together, e.g., all “url” buttons, all “suggestedResponse” buttons, etc.
  • Note: If a “phone” or “static URL” button is used in the template, their position (index) requires the “index” parameter of other buttons to be incremented accordingly.
  • See Example: WhatsApp Interactive Text Template with Mixed Buttons.
